subject: Aging is a networked failure: mitochondria, circadian clocks, and oxygen delivery converge
script: From Agewell Brief: Aging is a networked failure: mitochondria, circadian clocks, and oxygen delivery converge. A new special issue reframes aging as a multi-system process driven by shared mechanisms—mitochondrial dysfunction, circadian disruption, hypoxia, and inter-organ signaling—with vascular and immune shifts as upstream drivers. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
